title: Private Nashville Suite • Parking + Near Downtown
description:
Welcome to Sojourner Nashville, your globally inspired private guest suite in the peaceful Charlotte Park neighborhood of Nashville.

Perfect for couples, friends, or business travelers, this cozy retreat offers privacy, comfort, and convenient access to the best of Nashville—so you can explore by day and unwind at night.

Enjoy a thoughtfully designed space, a private patio, and modern amenities that make your stay both relaxing and seamless.

The space
This guest suite is designed with comfort and functionality in mind:

- Comfortable living area with plush seating
- Smart TV (log into your favorite streaming apps)
- Fast fiber WiFi—great for streaming or remote work

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements

- Private bedroom with queen bed
- Luxury queen air mattress for additional guests
- Best suited for 2–4 guests

🍳 Kitchenette Includes

- Mini fridge with ice tray
- Microwave
- Keurig coffee + tea bar
- Electric kettle
- Filtered water pitcher
- Ice tray

🛁 Bathroom Amenities

- Shampoo, conditioner, body wash
- Hair dryer
- Makeup towels + essentials

🧺 Bonus Features

- Washer + dryer (detergent included)
- Cleaning supplies available
- Curated local recommendations from 12+ years of living in Nashville

Guest access
Guests will enjoy:

- Private entrance with keyless self check-in
- One dedicated parking spot
- Full access to the guest suite and private patio

You’ll have the freedom to come and go easily throughout your stay.

Other things to note
- This is a private guest suite attached to a main home
- We are a family with two young children, so you may occasionally hear light noise during the day. We are mindful of our guests and do our best to maintain quiet hours between 9 PM – 6 AM
- An exterior security camera is located at the private entrance for guest safety and secure check-in
- The kitchenette is designed for light meal prep (no full stove/oven)

If you have any special requests, feel free to reach out—we’ll do our best to accommodate!
